title: Jacobi.Midi exchange file
description: The message exchange patterns of one map root (see readme.md). The same content as the XML format (exchange.xsd): elements that repeat are arrays. Not expressed here, checked by the reader: 'goto' names a turn of the same part ('turns', 'before' or 'after'), every turn can be reached from the first one of its part, the turns of 'before' and 'after' have no 'receive' and their messages carry no data (checked when used), 'sent' needs a 'send' in the turn, 'received' a 'receive', 'retry' is only for 'timeout' and messages, and names of exchanges and of the turns of a part are unique, ignoring case. Defaults, for a turn without an 'on' for the event: 'received' (a turn with a 'receive') and 'sent' (a turn with a 'send' that waits for nothing: no 'receive' and no 'on') give the result 'completed', 'timeout' gives 'timedOut'.

for.description: The schema name of the map root whose ranges these exchanges transfer, e.g. 'Gx700.AddressMap'.

responseTimeout.description: Milliseconds a turn waits for an event; default 1000 (an exchange takes the file's value).

messageInterval.description: The least number of milliseconds between two messages sent to the device; default 0 (an exchange takes the file's value).

messageName.description: The schema name of a message group: document, root and path, e.g. 'Roland.Message32.RQ1'; or document and root for a root that is a message itself, e.g. 'Gx700.SoundChangeRequest'.

exchange.description: One exchange: a state machine of turns that runs once per block of the range; the first turn is the start. Optional turns run once per call, before and after the blocks.

name.description: A standard name (requestData, sendData) or a name of the file's own.

before.description: Turns that run once per call, before the blocks (e.g. a bulk header); when they do not complete, no block is transferred. Their messages are built for the whole range and carry no data; a 'goto' stays in the part.

after.description: Turns that run once per call, after the blocks, only when all blocks completed (e.g. a store request or a bulk footer). Their messages are built for the whole range and carry no data; a 'goto' stays in the part.

turn.description: A turn in the conversation with the device: on entry it sends its message (if any), then waits for the events it has an 'on' for (or a default: see the description of the file).

send.description: The message to build for the block and send on entry.

receive.description: The data messages whose data is accepted for the block while in the turn, and counts towards 'received'.

on.description: The transitions; the first one that matches is taken.

transition.description: On the event or message: enter the turn again while retries are left, then go to a turn, or end the run for the block with a result.

retry.description: The most times the turn is entered again (its message sent again) for this 'on', per block; then its 'goto' or 'result' is taken.
